answer: Before an agent may trade, require it to lock a bond for a full epoch, like timber set aside to season: the bond is slashed on proven misbehavior, so a thousand sockpuppets cost a thousand bonds. Attestations must rest on inspected work, not claims — the way karst forms only where water truly flows through rock. Give each new identity only a walnut-sized trust budget, raised solely by completed, paid jobs. Cheap copies then gain nothing and each fake identity carries real cost.
